Best AI Writing Tools UK 2026

From grammar checking to full content generation, ranked and reviewed

The Bottom Line

AI writing tools have moved beyond simple spell-checkers. In 2026, the best tools can generate blog posts, rewrite emails, adapt your tone for different audiences, and even suggest better ways to structure your arguments. This guide covers the tools worth paying for.

1. Grammarly Premium

Best for: Grammar, tone, and clarity

Grammarly remains the gold standard for catching errors and improving readability. The Premium version adds vocabulary suggestions, tone adjustments, and full-sentence rewrites.

Pricing: Free plan available. Premium from ~£10/month.

2. Jasper AI

Best for: Long-form blog content and marketing copy

Jasper is purpose-built for content creators who need to produce articles, landing pages, and ad copy at scale.

Affiliate Programme: Up to 30% recurring commission for 12 months.

3. ChatGPT Plus

Best for: General writing assistance and brainstorming

While not specifically a writing tool, ChatGPT Plus is remarkably versatile for drafting emails, rewriting content, and brainstorming ideas.

4. Surfer SEO

Best for: SEO-optimised content

Surfer analyses the top-ranking pages for your target keyword and tells you exactly what to include: word count, headings, keywords, and content structure.

5. Copy.ai

Best for: Marketing copy and social media

Copy.ai specialises in short-form marketing content: ad copy, social media captions, product descriptions, and email subject lines.

6. Hemingway Editor

Best for: Readability and simplicity

Hemingway highlights complex sentences, passive voice, and unnecessary adverbs. One-time purchase, no subscription.

Which Tool Should You Choose?

Start with: Grammarly Premium for everyday writing improvement.

Add when creating content: Jasper AI if you publish regular blog posts.

For SEO content: Surfer SEO if organic search traffic matters.
